summary: Grandpa Jaroslav talked about his childhood in Kladno under the chimneys of the Poldi steelworks, where his dad František worked at the furnace. He remembered his mum Anna and her buns and his sister Věrka. With his friend Pepa Dvořák, who lived next door and was two years younger, he played football on the patch. He started telling how he and Pepa ran off to the fair in Prague in 1958, but saved the ending for next time.
